sourceMappingDecisions: Twenty rows map to twenty articles: eighteen physical additions, existing batch79 混ぜる, and baseline または.
交ぜる and 混ぜる share entry1290310/まぜる. Preserve the source's misleading intransitive English gloss, but teach the dictionary's transitive mix/stir/blend. The existing article already recognizes 交ぜる.
又は and または share entry1524990/または. Reuse the existing N4 kana article without changing its identity, title, reading, easier level or body.
Kana-primary またぐ, まとまる, まとめる, まぶしい, まぶた and まもなく preserve source spellings and dictionary identity. Written-primary metadata, not alternative spellings, determines primary component pairs.
inspectionStageAdvance.stage: Actual author reads completed before card drafting; not independent certification.
sourceAccessLimits: All fourteen selected complete family chunks, twenty-one complete older-body chunks and the complete three-kanji chunk actually read. Exact file lengths were checked; the unread tails of chunks13 and14 were then read through EOF.
The actual family union is326/861, including all twenty principals. The larger475-family prepared availability is not actual inspection.
All260 navigation labels and30 complete component records read; labels alone are not complete-body evidence. Also read both reuse targets directly.
All twenty frozen public lexical wrappers actually read: Digital Daijisen via Weblio is one authority, not twenty independent dictionaries or frequency evidence.
The classical またぐ【急ぐ／速ぐ】 heading is unrelated to assigned 跨ぐ1267830. Public extra single-minded, purity or street meanings are not silently assigned to selected principal sense indices.
The まもなく public capture verifies the shortly sense, not dictionary sense2's dictionary-form-verb attachment. The pinned full entry expressly supplies that attachment.
整理する was absent as a standalone pinned headword. Its removal from the strict collector does not make the compositional suru form invalid.
The confusable inventory and app's direct symmetric nontransitive exclusion semantics were inspected. No transitive closure or automatic POS/transitivity exemption is assumed.
Author reads are not independent review, exhaustive semantic uniqueness, native-speaker certification or measured model-bias reduction.

quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive draft judgments use complete actual titles, older bodies and ordinary secondary senses. No noun/verb or transitivity exemption, inherited clique or finding quota; reviewers may reject excesses and identify omissions.

またぐ includes stepping over, spanning and straddling; crossing titles are assessed directly. A riding/boarding title alone does not establish stepping over. またがる is a separate lexeme, not its progressive conjugation.
待合室 is a waiting room, not every meeting room or gathering. 待ち合わせる prior arrangement is assessed against broad meeting, encounter and assembly labels rather than all appointment/discussion words.
街角 overlaps broader corner labels but not every intersection, crossroads or angle. Missing 街 article does not remove the primary character from metadata.

真っ暗 includes hopelessness; 真っ黒 includes tanning and blackening; 真っ青 includes pallor; 真っ白 includes blankness. Direct color/darkness and secondary-sense labels are considered individually, not a color-category clique or rigid color/light partition.
真っ先 includes beginning/foremost/very-front uses. Sequence/head/front labels are compared directly without treating every first lifetime experience or exterior front surface as equivalent.

祭る includes enshrining and worship/prayer, not every party or festival. 窓口 includes a service counter and point of contact; broad window/reception/sales/contact labels are assessed independently, not every kitchen worktop or communication act.

まとまる and まとめる include collection, coherence, ordering, settling/completion and deciding. Broad titles are compared against those actual senses, not merely shared gathering/organization topics; transitivity alone does not remove quiz overlap.

真似る includes imitation/copying but 似る resemblance alone need not imply copying. まぶしい radiance is literal and figurative; brightness/glare/shine labels are examined directly without asserting every bright place hurts the eyes.

まぶた is eyelid, not every eye-related body part. マフラー overlaps スカーフ in clothing while retaining a distinct vehicle sense; a unique second sense does not by itself make an overlapping clothing choice safe.

まもなく soon/shortly is compared with complete soon/eventually/immediately titles and bodies; no fixed elapsed-time threshold is assumed. Dictionary-form verb+間もなく no-time-to construction is separately sourced and not frequency evidence.
Both reused cards and all prior exclusions remain unchanged. Existing direct declarations still apply symmetrically; no duplicate declaration is required on the new endpoint.
